text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Classic Triple Crown, 
the presence of her rivals— Duramente's 
fellow generation—cannot be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Among them, Satono Crown stood out. She 
was currently the most highly acclaimed 
runner of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Being roommates who knew each other so 
well, they held a deep mutual respect for 
one another.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Both Kitasan Black and Cheval Grand are 
promising Umamusume. They are sure to make 
their presence known in the future.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, even among such formidable 
rivals, Duramente's running was nothing 
short of "overwhelming."
